notes: Sunday: 6-a-side football, expect ~6 km of rapid intervals. Monday was the all-out baseline 5K. Happy to run the rest as needed. Aiming for sub-20 by 10 Dec. Thu/Fri swapped: big meal Thursday evening, so easy run Thursday and intervals Friday.
summary: Week 1 of 6. Monday's 22:04 sets your baseline at VDOT 44.4; sub-20 needs 49.9, so you need about +1 VDOT a week for five weeks. That's roughly double a typical rate, so every week has to count. This week absorbs Monday's all-out effort, then puts one sharp session on Thursday at 4:06–4:10/km, already between your interval pace (4:18) and goal pace (4:00). Sunday's football is your second hard day, so Saturday is fully off. Running goes up from ~14 km a week recently to ~25 km this week, the main risk. If calves or shins complain after Thursday, cut Friday to 3 km or skip it.

sessions.title: Rest
tips: 10 min of mobility: calves, hips, hamstrings.

sessions.title: Easy run + strides
sessions.details: 6 km easy, then 6 × 20 s strides with 60 s walk-back.
tips: If power goes above 300 W, slow down.
Strides: fast but relaxed, not a sprint.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic run
tips: Leave 2–3 h after a big meal, or keep the first 10 min very gentle.
Keep HR under 155 — slow down if it climbs.

sessions.title: Intervals: 6 × 800 m
sessions.details: 2 km warm-up + 4 × 20 s strides · 6 × 800 m @ 4:06–4:10/km (3:17–3:20 per rep), 2 min easy jog between · 1.5 km cool-down.
tips: Track or flat loop. Lap every rep.
Keep every rep within 2 s of the others.
Can't hold 4:10 by rep 5? Stop at 5.

sessions.title: 6-a-side football (≈6 km of sprints)
sessions.details: Match play, ≈6 km of sprints. Counts as this week's second hard session — no extra running.
tips: Warm up 10 min: jog, leg swings, short sprints.
Log it on Strava so next week accounts for it.
